title: P5_legal_answerer answer
description: The agent's final answer is plain text with [n] citation markers, optionally starting with [NOT_FOUND] or [CONFLICT]. Markers are checked against the excerpts retrieved, and numbers against the excerpts and the message, in code (n8n/src/lib/legal_check.js). Spec 10.6 lists a JSON shape; plain text is used because the AI Agent node's final answer is text (D-087).
